test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct with regard to the effect of globalisation on India and other developing countries?

options.text: Flow of information became highly restricted.
It led to increased inequality between countries.
Flow of international capital got restricted.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It led to increased inequality between countries.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Globalization has often resulted in widening the gap between developed and developing countries due to differences in economic, technological, and resource capacities.
 
• Developing countries like India have faced challenges in competing with developed nations, leading to increased economic disparities.
 
• The benefits of globalization have not been equally distributed, with wealthier nations often reaping more significant advantages.
 
• Globalization has sometimes exacerbated income inequality within countries, as certain sectors and regions benefit more than others.
 
• While globalization has led to significant economic growth, it has also highlighted and sometimes deepened existing inequalities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Globalization:**

 
 
• The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.
 
• It involves the increased interconnectedness and interdependence of economies, societies, and cultures through cross-border trade, investment, and information technology.
 
 
 
• **Economic Disparities:**
 
 
• Differences in income, wealth, and economic opportunities between different groups within a society or between different countries.
 
• Can be measured by indicators such as the Gini coefficient, which assesses income inequality within a population.
 
 
 
• **Technological Advancement:**
 
 
• Refers to the development and application of new tools, machines, and techniques that help improve efficiency and productivity.
 
• While technological progress can drive economic growth, it can also lead to job displacement and increased inequality if not managed inclusively.
 
 
 
• **Trade Liberalization:**
 
 
• The removal or reduction of trade barriers such as tariffs and quotas to facilitate easier and more efficient cross-border trade.
 
• Can lead to increased market access for businesses but may also result in domestic industries facing stiff competition from foreign firms.
 
 
 
• **Income Inequality:**
 
 
• The unequal distribution of income within a population, where some individuals or groups earn significantly more than others.
 
• High levels of income inequality can have social and economic repercussions, including reduced social mobility and increased social tensions.
